desc: Implement the `countGoodArrays` method using the combinatorial formula: $m \times (m-1)^{n-1-k} \times \binom{n-1}{k} \pmod{10^9+7}$. This includes precomputing factorials and their modular inverses for efficient binomial coefficient calculation.
Compute the binomial coefficient C(n-1, k) modulo 10^9 + 7 using precomputed factorials and their modular inverses.
Calculate (m-1) raised to the power of (n-1-k) modulo 10^9 + 7 using fast exponentiation.
Multiply the results of the binomial coefficient, m, and the power term, taking modulo 10^9 + 7 at each step to prevent overflow.
Handle edge cases where m=1 (if k != n-1, result is 0; if k == n-1, result is 1) and ensure k is within valid bounds [0, n-1].
Return the final computed result as an integer.
